description: This file declares the SetVolume class, which is a task for setting the volume in a WebAudio player context within the Rialto server. It includes class definition, constructor, destructor, and execute method, along with private members for context, gstWrapper, and volume.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A task class responsible for setting the volume in the WebAudio player context.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the given context, gstWrapper, and volume.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set the volume.
